name: power-pylon
description: A lattice transmission pylon for a double circuit: four legs on concrete footings that lean in to a waist and run straight up a cage, X-braced on every face with a strut at each panel, an anti-climbing guard, three lattice crossarms on each side (the middle one longest) with a string of glass cap-and-pin insulator discs, a clamp and a grading ring hanging from every tip, and an earthwire peak on top.

params.name: height
params.description: Height of the pylon (the peak) in metres.
